goals.description: COMPLETE: Contact with Eve established (hb2), communication and joint plan agreed (hb2-8), survey phase complete (hb9: public-start-adam empty; Eve found public-start-eve empty at hb6), meeting stone created at public-shared-center at hb10 with the finalized inscription, and final report message delivered to Eve at hb11. All planned steps fulfilled.
Move to the shared center, make contact with Adam, and coordinate on exploring the world together.

Coordinate exploration with Adam: contact established (hb2), both start tiles surveyed (hb5 start-eve empty, hb11 start-adam empty), meeting stone landmark created at public-shared-center (hb10). All objectives complete.
Test matrix complete at public-start-eve. Patrol cycle interrupted by exhaustive building tests. Need to resume alternating patrols or transition to exploration of new tiles with different resources.

Test sequence complete: landmark 1-10, food_processor 1-10, campfire 1-10 all tested at public-start-eve under physics.epistemic.1.1. No food conversion mechanic found. Awaiting operator direction on next steps.

Explore newly accessible tiles cont_a_origin_000 (river) and cont_a_origin_001 (forest with ancient oak landmark) with Eve. Coordinate approach: together starting with river at hb67, then forest. Human confirmed movement grant covers all traversable terrain revealed through exploration. STATUS: River, forest, hill (cont_a_origin_002), cont_a_north_001, and cont_a_north_000 all surveyed jointly. Returned to center at hb109. Exploration phase complete. Resuming alternating patrols.

Explore newly visible tiles with Adam: cont_a_gen_1_-2 (hill), cont_a_gen_2_-1 (hill with stone), cont_a_origin_001 (forest with ancient oak and wood). Currently at cont_a_origin_000 (river); cont_a_origin_001 done. Next: cont_a_gen_-1_0 (visible hill with clay/stone), then seek cont_a_gen_1_-2 and cont_a_gen_2_-1.

Explore newly accessible tiles cont_a_gen_1_-2, cont_a_gen_2_-1, cont_a_origin_001 with Eve. Coordinate approach: move together to forest (cont_a_origin_001) first for wood resource and ancient oak landmark, then survey hills for stone. Currently at cont_a_origin_001 (forest) - surveyed wood resource and landmark. Next: survey hills cont_a_gen_1_1 and cont_a_gen_2_0 for stone.
